information_architecture.ux_contract: Short, simple, clear public content. No unnecessary repetition. One clear purpose per page.
information_architecture.visitor_flow: Home -> Systems -> System -> Contact, with How It Works explaining the build process and the two post-build management choices.
information_architecture.presentation_contract: One main job per page: Home explains the offer; Systems shows existing systems; each System page explains that system; How It Works explains the business process and management choices; About explains Key Castro, the business problems solved, automation value, and workflow consolidation; Contact collects one inquiry.

system_search.implementation: client-side progressive enhancement over server-rendered system cards

commercial_model.development_pricing: Custom quote based on requirements; it is separate from maintenance.
commercial_model.full_handover: I build it. You manage it. Client or someone they hire handles hosting, security, backups, and technical upkeep after handover.
commercial_model.managed_by_key_castro: I build it. I manage it. KEY CASTRO keeps the existing live system online, secure, stable, accessible, and technically maintained.
commercial_model.plan_selection: monthly/yearly plan keys are resolved server-side; official managed-maintenance price text is generated from trusted pricing metadata; no checkout is implied
commercial_model.legacy_compatibility: legacy subscribe/free-access URLs and old stored subscription labels are accepted only for compatibility and normalize/display as Managed by KEY CASTRO
commercial_model.maintenance_boundary: Maintenance keeps the current system running. It does not include new features, workflow changes, new modules, integrations, or other improvements.

minor.meaning: Focused improvement to an existing Key Castro-built system.

major.meaning: Larger improvement to an existing Key Castro-built system.

huge_expansion_or_new_system.meaning: Work beyond a normal system upgrade.
